correctness.rationale: The Carathéodory parametrization is exact for the locally biholomorphic positive-real-part class: tβ=cosβ exp(-iβ), the integral logarithmic derivative yields f′ nonvanishing, and H=tβ²[6c1c3−4c2²+tβ c1²c2−tβ² c1⁴]/144 follows from Taylor coefficients. The two-step Schur parametrization exhausts c1,c2,c3. At β=0 the global compact bound 1/8 has the unique normalized maximizer r=1/2,x=-1; the outward radial derivative of |H| at ρ=1 equals 7/32+Re(y)/8≥3/32, uniformly in |y|≤1, so all nearby optimizers remain on |x|=1. Independently reconstructed the exact Hessian Frr=−1/9, Fφφ=−3/512, Fφβ=−5/768, Fββ=−29/384 for F=|H|². The negative definite boundary Hessian and implicit function theorem give φ′=−10/9 and M=1/8−59β²/432+O(β⁴); conjugation makes M even. The explicit Blaschke witness satisfies the class and yields the positive gap M−B=41β²/864+O(β⁴). Numerical β=.1 is illustrative only.
